notebook:
Solves 50/50 (budget spent). Best valid = 0.000 (empty plant).

KEY LESSONS:
- Value formula: flow(mol/s)*price($/mol)*8000h*3600s/1e6 = $M/yr (table matches e.g. nC4 450*0.0128*28.8=166).
- C5mix blend (iC5+nC5=695 mol/s, 85% mean 0.0309) = ~$618M/yr IF >=95% pure. Cut gaps: nC4(272.7)/iC5(301.0)=28K easy; nC5(309.2)/2,2-DMB(322.9)=13.7K moderate.
- My 2/3-column trees cost $200-360M/yr and none reached 95% => revenue 0, negative reward. Cost is dominated by the big first feed column (~$130-213M/yr).
- Empty plant = 0.000 is the safe score; any impure multi-column plant loses money.

STRATEGY: To ever profit, must get >=95% on >=1 blend/pure stream with minimal columns. A 1-column sharp feed split (e.g. C4-/C5+) can't make C5mix alone (needs both ends cut). A 2-column train (C4- tops / C5+ bottoms, then C5 tops / C6+ bottoms) is the minimal C5mix route but must be made cheaper (fewer stages, low reflux) than tried.

FINAL: budget exhausted; reverted to empty = 0.000.
